name: fleet
description: Per project: a roster of permanent background sessions started with /fleet up from a template, each seeded, budgeted, paced by a cadence and placed in the panel; they ask you without stopping and you answer from any session with /fleet, at no token cost; nothing of the project leaves to a third party without your approval of the exact draft; a session that read outside content is marked, and command-level files change only when you apply a drafted change or ask for it yourself; a stale write of a shared file is refused once; records cited by version turn their citers suspect when revised; /fleet brief shows the project at a glance
